scenarios.label: Free Throw Precision
scenarios.objective: Repeatable target alignment and release timing.
pass_criteria: release timing is within synthetic tolerance
scenarios.failure_policy: Expose the miss and request review.

scenarios.label: Obstacle Recovery
scenarios.objective: Recover from a blocked path without hiding the failure.
scenarios.failure_policy: Stop at the authority boundary when confidence falls.

scenarios.label: Teleop Handoff
scenarios.objective: Make the transition from policy suggestion to human control visible.
pass_criteria: human approval is required before movement
scenarios.failure_policy: Return control to the human and preserve the record.

scenarios.label: Energy Budget
scenarios.objective: Complete a session while reporting energy and thermal assumptions.
scenarios.failure_policy: End the run if the budget is exceeded.
